title: DEEPFAKEBENCH-MM: A COMPREHENSIVE BENCHMARK FOR MULTIMODAL DEEPFAKE DETECTION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the Area Under the Curve (AUC) performance scores of multimodal deepfake detectors across male and female demographic subgroups.
Evaluating and comparing the AUC performance scores of deepfake detectors across four skin tone subgroups (white, black, yellow, and brown) to assess demographic fairness.
Testing multimodal detectors on single-modality inputs (video-only vs. audio-only) and comparing the AUC scores to measure the models' over-reliance on visual cues over audio cues.

Evaluating cross-pipeline generalization using performance heatmaps and t-SNE visualizations to see if models disproportionately rely on specific generative artifacts (e.g., Entire Face Synthesis vs. Face Swapping) rather than generalizable forgery cues.
